text:
Happy Tuesday! We're starting off cold and gray, right around freezing, but don't let the early look fool you. High pressure is parked just to our southwest, and that's going to keep us quiet and dry for days. The clouds should give way to a mostly sunny afternoon with a high near 53, a good 10 degrees above normal for mid-November. It's a light-breeze kind of day, so the only thing you'll want is a jacket for the morning. The sun sets a little after 4:20, so get your walk or ride in earlier rather than later.

Tonight turns mostly cloudy and a lot milder, with a low around 39, so tomorrow morning won't be nearly as frosty. Wednesday is partly sunny with a high near 56. The forecasters and the models all agree on that, though one of the TV outlets leans a few degrees warmer, so a spot or two could flirt with 60. The mild, dry run continues through Saturday, and showers hold off until late Sunday. No umbrella needed for now. Just enjoy it.
